harnessCorrections: Wait for document.fonts.ready and finite animations before geometry and axe; theme/route transitions otherwise caused transient sidebar contrast failures.
Inspect background-grid DOM with includeHidden while the modal correctly hides the rest of the document from the accessibility tree. No accessibility thresholds or rules were relaxed.

sharedLimitations: Both header metadata slots display a bare total count (12), without visible context.
Both Request columns clip long titles without an ellipsis. Detail sheets expose the complete title, but cell presentation remains incomplete.
differences: A puts title before ID and uses plain priority text; B puts ID before title and uses colored priority tags.
B’s longer mobile description wraps to an extra line. Both retain shared horizontal header/search alignment and typography.

productDecisions.contract: Cancel closes without adding a record. The brief does not define whether a later reopen retains the draft.
productDecisions.a: Discarded when Cancel closes the modal.
productDecisions.b: Retained when Cancel closes the modal.
productDecisions.decision: Underspecified. A is selected for the example; a reusable product policy should explicitly choose retention, discard, or confirmation for unsaved work.

limits: Only the Requests page was independently generated. Both agents received the same shared shell, Customers page, pattern implementations, local dataset, task brief and installed kit.
The reports exercise prebuilt original candidate distributions; their asset hashes are captured. The candidate sources are unchanged and pass no-emit type checking.
The original kit is identified by the recorded tarball and integrity hashes. Later final-kit verification is separate evidence.
Two modes and two widths in Chromium, ten axe scenarios per candidate, and the named interaction flows are bounded checks, not complete accessibility or responsive certification.
Screenshots were inspected for the listed observations; they are not approved visual regression baselines. Known clipping and bare-count limitations remain in the untouched candidate sources.
The dependency snapshot was copied locally; a clean registry installation was not verified. This local demo has no backend, live telemetry or production integration.
selectedSourceStage: Exact original selected at adoption, before post-selection presentation corrections
